_about: THE MENU of time-stretch settings for his icy (electronics/sc/icylab.scd), found by ear in the icy lab; each with his words on how it sounds. For every piece. A setting is the knobs of /le/icy do set. Started 2026-11-07 with the smooth end of his spectrum (the Switch~ piece's RUNNING_LOG §54), the AI's proposals until his ear has spoken. A setting names its voice: stretch (PaulStretch — the drone end) · grain (GrainBuf — the textured end) · warp (his Warp1 as it was).

entries.name: drone C — stretch 2.97 s
entries.proposed_by: AI 2026-11-07 (after his ear on the granular smooth end, §55)
entries.why: a 3 s window: the stillest, the most washed

entries.name: drone B — stretch 1.49 s
entries.proposed_by: AI 2026-11-07 (after his ear on the granular smooth end, §55)

entries.name: drone A — stretch 0.74 s
entries.proposed_by: AI 2026-11-07 (after his ear on the granular smooth end, §55)
entries.why: PaulStretch with a ¾ s window: the quickest-moving of the drones

entries.name: smooth A — glass
entries.why: long grains, many overlaps, a soft window, the hop broken up by length variation and a little scatter: the granular reading of PaulStretch (big windows, randomized phase, Hann)

entries.name: smooth B — softer
entries.why: longer still, a Gaussian window (no edges), more overlap

entries.name: smooth C — washed
entries.why: the most randomized: no periodicity left at all, at the cost of any attack

entries.name: default — Approaching's icy
entries.why: his most-used icy in Approaching: 0.6 s grains, 17 overlaps, expodec — an attack in every grain, the textured side of smooth
